name: B7000001.RDB
title: Gatehouse
note: A guard hall where four corridors meet, pillars at the crossing.

name: N7000001.RDB
title: Hall of Pillars
note: A great hall of columns; the four corridors run into it.

name: B7000002.RDB
title: Bone Gallery
note: A barrow hall, a coffin in every alcove.

name: B7000003.RDB
title: Cavern Mouth
note: Natural rock: a chain of chambers with stalagmites.

name: B7000004.RDB
title: Cistern
note: A round vaulted cistern; the four lower corridors run into it.

name: N7000002.RDB
title: Crypt of Niches
note: A ring passage round a vault of coffins; one narrow way in.

name: B7000005.RDB
title: Ruined Cloister
note: A square court, columns half down.

name: N7000003.RDB
title: Sunken Arena
note: A circular fighting floor, a ring of cages and columns on a step above.

name: B7000006.RDB
title: Switchback Stair
note: A double flight down 19.2 m: upper ports N and W, lower ports N, S and E.

name: N7000004.RDB
title: Throne Room
note: A long hall to a throne on a two-step dais.

name: N7000005.RDB
title: Warren
note: A maze of crossing passages on a four-cell lattice.

name: N7000006.RDB
title: Collapsed Passage
note: A tunnel broken into caves, half of it fallen.

name: N7000007.RDB
title: Cruciform Chapel
note: A high-roofed cross: nave north-south, transept east-west, an altar at the crossing.

name: N7000008.RDB
title: Forge Hall
note: Braziers burn along a long hall of slab anvils.

name: N7000009.RDB
title: Hourglass
note: Two round chambers and a narrow neck between them.

name: N7000010.RDB
title: Library of Slabs
note: Reading stands and slab tables in ordered rows.

name: N7000011.RDB
title: Ossuary
note: A long low hall, bones heaped on every side.

name: N7000012.RDB
title: Pit Hall
note: A walled-in pit with its own ramp: the loot is below.

name: N7000013.RDB
title: Prison Block
note: A cellblock: gated cells off a long passage.

name: N7000014.RDB
title: Sump Tunnels
note: Low wet tunnels in the rock, the lower corridors all meeting here.

name: N7000015.RDB
title: Altar Cave
note: Natural rock, an altar and a ring of standing stones.

name: N7000016.RDB
title: Barracks
note: A guardroom passage with small rooms on both sides.

name: B7000007.RDB
title: Barrow Gate
note: A square court with an arch at each entrance and a well in the middle.

name: B7000008.RDB
title: Causeway
note: Two causeways cross a pit 3.2 m deep; a ramp leads down into each of its four corners.

name: N7000017.RDB
title: Cistern Vaults
note: A low square hall, a grid of short columns.

name: B7000009.RDB
title: Colonnade Gallery
note: A broad east-west hall, two rows of columns.

name: N7000018.RDB
title: Crossroads Pillar
note: An octagonal hall, one huge column in the middle and four about it.

name: B7000010.RDB
title: Four Shrines
note: Cross corridors with a small shrine off each quarter.

name: N7000019.RDB
title: Gallery of Statues
note: Statues stand in two rows down a long lower hall.

name: N7000020.RDB
title: Great Stairwell
note: A double flight down 19.2 m: upper ports W and N, lower ports W, E and S.

name: B7000011.RDB
title: Lantern Hall
note: Braziers burn all along a wide lower hall.

name: N7000021.RDB
title: Mausoleum
note: A north-south aisle lined with niches of coffins.

name: B7000012.RDB
title: Octagon Chapel
note: An eight-sided chapel with an altar and eight columns.

name: N7000022.RDB
title: Pier Hall
note: Four massive piers of masonry stand in a square hall.

name: N7000023.RDB
title: Round Keep
note: A ring passage round a drum-shaped keep, entered by one door.

name: B7000013.RDB
title: Ruined Crossing
note: A round hall at the crossing, its roof and columns half down.

name: N7000024.RDB
title: Sinkhole
note: A vast round cave, stone fangs hanging and rubble heaped below.

name: B7000014.RDB
title: Terraced Cavern
note: Rock in three terraces, each 0.4 m above the last.

name: N7000025.RDB
title: Tomb of Kings
note: A high hall; on its stepped platform a great sarcophagus guarded by statues.

name: N7000026.RDB
title: Torture Chamber
note: A central chamber of cages and slabs, small cells off the western passage.
